question: Should the 2026-11-01 TWO_PI decision (0x0124F2B8 a named extern const double, 'literal pools are per TU') be revisited?
context: VC7.1 emits a float literal as a COMDAT __real@<bits> section (LINK_ONCE_DISCARD, select-any; NF418 probe/p1.obj), so the linker merges it exe-wide; a named const (static or header const) gets its own per-TU storage. Census (evidence/floatpool.tsv): 1.0f at 0x0122DED8 has 2912 x87 refs from 154 64K regions, 0.0f at 0x0122DEDC 3667 from 169 -- one merged entry per value, the other same-value VAs are named per-TU consts. 0x0124F2B8 (161 refs, 42 regions, the only VA holding that double) fits a merged __real@401921fb60000000 as well as an extern const; DELTA_NOTIONAL_ZERO has PDB evidence (Ego_d PUB32), TWO_PI does not.
proposal: Keep TWO_PI as decided (no PDB contradiction; NF418 kept it) unless the owner prefers literals for unproven single-VA constants; either way respell the extern-C twin _TWO_PI (NAME_FIXES.tsv).
